intent: One compact LuHmOS JavaScript entry point behind the canonical apex HTTPS URL; serve approved static UI modules and art through directory paths with edge caching and reproducible signed-off release receipts.

publicPresentation.note: Browser developer tools can reveal network delivery infrastructure. URLs can be branded, but the origin/provider cannot be made completely secret by URL rewriting.

oneServiceModel.deployment: Cloudflare Workers with static assets under matching /assets/ directory or approved HTTPS origin with Cloudflare Cache Rules
oneServiceModel.originResponsibility: Render currently; persistent Ubuntu origin later only with confirmed runtime, certificate and owner-approved cutover
oneServiceModel.buildPipeline: pinned npm lockfile -> minify or bundle via reviewed build -> content-hash -> immutable approved static upload -> atomic small manifest update

fourMinimalModules.role: tiny deterministic bootstrap and plugin registry, no provider secrets, no data writes
original vector, CSS, jQuery compatibility and four-layer parallax, loaded only if needed
short-revalidating manifest with approved content hashes, names and optional SRI; on-demand heavy media
typed call to /mcp or verified host tool only, with no caching and per-tool authority

dnsScope.cloudflare: managed public DNS, optional proxied edge/Workers, TLS and cache

recordsPerRealNeed.TXT: ownership proof, ACME DNS-01 or custom metadata when required
recordsPerRealNeed.MX: only if email is actually hosted for domain
recordsPerRealNeed.PTR: IP-prefix operator controlled reverse DNS, not required for static assets
recordsPerRealNeed.SRV: only if a client/service protocol needs explicit discovery

dnsScope.privateResolver: existing dnsmasq for eggiebagelface.lan; BIND9 optional not reverse proxy

encryption.publicHttp: edge redirect only after valid matching edge certificate; application-generated MCP URLs always https
encryption.redirectOwner: one verified edge redirect owner, avoid loops and redirects of sensitive streaming MCP requests
encryption.edgeOrigin: Cloudflare Full (strict) when proxied, verified matching certificate
encryption.tunnelOrigin: cloudflared verifies CA and originServerName if HTTPS Tunnel later
encryption.privateServiceTransport: TLS when TCP/networked; use permission-bounded Unix sockets for intra-host non-network IPC when appropriate
encryption.hsts: propose only after verifying all in-scope hosts and rollback consequences

cache.immutable: only approved content-hashed public JS/CSS/vector art and static images
cache.mcp: no-store, no CDN caching, preserve streaming/POST headers
cache.thirdPartyLibraries: pin and inspect at build time; do not execute floating latest code at runtime
cache.integrity: SHA-256 release manifest and optional SHA-384 subresource integrity for cross-origin permitted usage

vendorPortability.otherWebApps: Load branded HTTPS entry only if app controls HTML and CSP allows it; otherwise bundle assets or use approved host extension/MCP resource
vendorPortability.chatGpt: Inside MCP App resource sandbox only; cannot inject code across native ChatGPT interface
vendorPortability.offlineFallback: local small vector and accessible text controls
vendorPortability.mobileDegradation: reuse existing full/balanced/lite/static render budget while preserving corrective draft and Undo

release.packageCompatibleUpdateWithoutReinstall: possible for static resource body without new host contract
release.breakingConnectorHostnameOrToolContract: requires independent compatibility and possible reconnection

openQuestionsForNextClass: confirm whether one Worker delivers static asset paths or the reverse proxy alone handles them
reconcile current mcp.eggiebagelface.art candidate with proposed apex /mcp
verify Cloudflare zone and Worker deployment permissions and budget before activation
